name: Handle
description: Gives Handle a sturdier view of your open Chrome tabs — native tab groups, race-free screenshots, console errors — and passively indexes the pages you actually read so you can search them later. Connects only to Handle's local server (127.0.0.1:4910). Nothing leaves your machine.
